what: [SCOPE-REDUCTION] Plan retargets design-step5c guard release from the existing terminal sentinel to the earlier step sentinel
scenario_or_breakage: design-step5c.sh writes .completed/step-5c before status env, final-summary rendering, report sidecar emission, and the later .completed/step-5c-terminal write. If a premature notification fires after step-5c, the proposed hook change releases the guard while the wrapper is still running and allows result-artifact reads before the task boundary.
suggested_fix: Keep marker_step_completed on .completed/step-5c-terminal. Update tests to assert .completed/step-5c alone does not release the guard, and .completed/step-5c-terminal does. Drop the mismatch-fix portion unless the wrapper terminal sentinel is removed intentionally.
